theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis: iodide uptake, peroxide and anion exchange
core_role: The shared pathways are the thyroid-specific core of hormonogenesis, NIS-mediated iodide uptake and thyroid hormone generation and transport, which the theme supports with H2O2 generation and SLC26 (pendrin-type) anion exchange.

theme: RNA modification in ribosome and translation machinery biogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the mitochondrial instance of the theme: rRNA/mRNA modification and mitoribosome subunit assembly enabling mitochondrial translation, set against the broader nuclear-cytosolic tRNA, rRNA and snRNA modification machinery.

theme: HDL assembly and reverse cholesterol transport
core_role: The shared pathways frame ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and nascent HDL formation as the initiating step of reverse cholesterol transport, upstream of lipoprotein remodeling and LXR-regulated macrophage lipid homeostasis.

theme: Cilium biogenesis, ciliary trafficking and motility
core_role: The shared pathways are the centriole and basal body foundation of cilia, centriole duplication, basal body docking and control of cilium assembly and disassembly, on which intraflagellar trafficking and motile axoneme function are built.

theme: Apoptosis via death receptors and the mitochondrial pathway
core_role: The shared pathways are the extrinsic arm of cell death, death-receptor (Fas, TRAIL, TNF, TLR3/TRIF) signalling through caspase-8, c-FLIP and RIPK1 necroptosis, which via BID cleavage feeds the mitochondrial BCL-2/apoptosome execution pathway.

theme: Renal water and salt homeostasis and osmoregulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the vasopressin-aquaporin water-reabsorption arm of body fluid homeostasis, alongside renal sodium, potassium and chloride transport and cellular osmotic responses.

theme: Antigen processing and presentation by MHC molecules
core_role: The shared pathways are general and MHC class I/Ib antigen presentation (including lipid antigens), complemented by MHC class II presentation of exogenous peptides in B cells.

theme: GABA neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover GABA synthesis and its reuptake into cells, forming the production-and-recycling half of the GABA life cycle completed by its secretion and degradation.

theme: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fibre assembly
core_role: The shared pathways are collagen biosynthesis and fibril organisation together with elastic fibre assembly, i.e. building the structural fibres of the extracellular matrix that crosslinking then stabilises.

theme: Oxidative and hypoxic stress responses and cell death
core_role: The shared pathways are the sensing of oxidative and hypoxic insults (H2O2, hydroperoxides, H2S, ischemia, oxygen), which the theme links to regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis.

theme: One-carbon folate-methionine metabolism and nucleotide synthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the folate and methionine/SAM one-carbon cycle, framed as the supplier of one-carbon units for de novo purine and thymidylate synthesis and nucleotide metabolism.

theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
core_role: The shared pathways are the growth-cone outputs of guidance, semaphorin-driven repulsion and positive or negative control of axon extension, on which netrin, ephrin, Slit-Robo and L1 signalling converge.

theme: Cytosolic calcium signalling and homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways cover calcium entry and store release (voltage-gated channels, caffeine-sensitive ryanodine release) and sequestration, which the theme balances with Na+/Ca2+ exchange to lower cytosolic calcium.

theme: Myeloid innate inflammatory activation and TLR regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the generic monocyte-driven inflammatory and myeloid effector response, which the theme places under control of TLR, CD40 and antigen-presentation signalling in dendritic cells and monocytes.

theme: Cadherin-based cell-cell adhesion and junctions
core_role: The shared pathways are adherens and apical junction adhesion structures, including their apoptotic cleavage, read here as the cadherin (CDH1/CDH11) calcium-dependent adhesion system whose trafficking and degradation are regulated.

theme: Eicosanoid and specialised pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the cyclooxygenase and P450 epoxygenase branches of arachidonic acid metabolism producing prostanoids and their receptors, alongside the lipoxygenase leukotriene, lipoxin and resolvin branches.

theme: Nucleic acid base editing and demethylation
core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC cytidine deamination used as antiviral restriction of viral genomes, within the broader theme of enzymatic base editing (ADAR) and DNA demethylation/alkylation reversal.

theme: tRNA aminoacylation and modification for translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging plus anticodon wobble modifications, framed as the core mechanisms guaranteeing accurate decoding.

theme: mRNA translation initiation, termination and quality control
core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination and ribosome/mRNA surveillance at stop codons and stalls (NMD, no-go, non-stop decay), the terminal and quality-control end of the translation cycle that begins with initiation.

theme: Pancreatic endocrine lineage development
core_role: The shared pathways are the progenitor stages of pancreatic lineage specification and their transcriptional control, the early steps leading to endocrine (and exocrine) cell differentiation.

theme: Hemostasis: VWF-platelet adhesion, coagulation and fibrinolysis
core_role: The shared pathways are von Willebrand factor-mediated primary hemostasis (VWF binding to GPIb and collagen, ADAMTS13 cleavage) and its disease variants, coupled to the coagulation factor cascade and fibrinolysis.

theme: Renal salt transport and osmotic regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are renal sodium/chloride transport and cellular osmotic volume responses, implemented by SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and potassium channels whose defects cause Bartter and Gitelman syndromes.

theme: Platelet activation via integrin and GPCR signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling and cytoskeletal remodelling via Rap1, talin, p130Cas and GRB2:SOS, the adhesion arm of platelet activation triggered by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and GPVI receptors.

theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation
core_role: The shared pathways are peroxisome maintenance and cofactor/acyl-CoA handling (fission, TYSND1 processing, NAD transport, medium-chain and malonyl-CoA metabolism) that support peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated suppression of T cell responses
core_role: The shared pathways are the suppression of effector T cell activation, proliferation and IFN-gamma/Th17 output together with induction of regulatory T cells, i.e. the tolerance arm of T cell costimulatory regulation.

theme: Viral attachment, entry and host manipulation
core_role: The shared pathways are coronavirus manipulation of host signalling and junctional PDZ proteins, the post-entry host-interaction phase alongside viral attachment, entry and assembly.

theme: Amino acid catabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the alanine-to-oxaloacetate route into gluconeogenesis, alongside threonine, choline and carnitine-related amino acid metabolism.

theme: DNA repair at replication forks with ADP-ribosylation and chromatin
core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA-structural side of genome maintenance, topological change, fork reversal, R-loop processing and repair pathway choice, regulated by PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodelling.

theme: Kidney development: nephron progenitor and growth control
core_role: The shared pathways are control of nephron progenitor maintenance, proliferation, survival and kidney size, the growth-regulating core of metanephric development whose segments form tubules and ducts.

theme: NK cell regulation and cytotoxicity
core_role: The shared pathways are KIR-mediated inhibitory control of NK cell activation and tolerance, balanced against granzyme cytotoxicity and MHC class Ib recognition.

theme: RNA processing, surveillance and decay
core_role: The shared pathways are cytoplasmic translational quality control and RNA decay (NMD, ribosome rescue, RQC and degron-mediated protein disposal), the surveillance end of an RNA life cycle that includes nuclear transcription, splicing, 3'-end processing and export.

theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell-cycle checkpoints
core_role: The shared pathways are p53 activation and its control (phosphorylation, COP1, tetramerization loss) driving damage-induced apoptosis, within cell-cycle checkpoint control and ARF-dependent tumour suppression.

theme: Tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and reactive aldehyde detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and repair of glycated proteins, a redox damage-control arm that the theme pairs with tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ metabolism.

theme: RAS-RAF-ERK MAPK signalling and negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways are RAF/ERK activation and its phosphatase-mediated negative feedback, including RASopathy-associated MRAS/SHOC2 and MAP2K mutants, as the core control loop of MAPK signalling.

theme: Regulation of proteasomal protein degradation
core_role: The shared pathways are the promotion of ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and protein destabilization (plus stabilization), framed against negative regulation of proteolysis in the control of protein turnover.

theme: tRNA and protein modifications supporting translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA anticodon modifications and aminoacylation ensuring decoding fidelity, alongside wybutosine, diphthamide and protein hydroxylation modifications of translation components.

theme: Oncogene-induced cellular senescence
core_role: The shared pathways are the induction of senescence and arrest of cell-cycle re-entry by oncogenic signalling, which is executed through senescence-associated heterochromatin formation.

theme: Catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis and their synaptic reuptake and transport, implemented by SLC6 transporters (whose defects cause disease) and vesicular loading.

theme: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
core_role: The shared pathways are cellular clearance of amyloid-beta and its regulation, opposing amyloid fibril formation and complemented by transcytotic clearance.

theme: Myeloid inflammatory activation and neutrophil degranulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the generic myeloid inflammatory effector response, neutrophil degranulation, complement and TLR signalling, of monocytes and neutrophils.

theme: Post-transcriptional mRNA decay and small RNA silencing
core_role: The shared pathways are the cytoplasmic mRNA turnover machinery (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, stabilization), the effector step through which miRNA silencing and ARE-binding proteins regulate mRNA fate.

theme: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
core_role: The shared pathways are 3'-end processing and termination of replication-dependent histone pre-mRNAs, the maturation step preceding nuclear export of mature mRNAs.

theme: Synaptic plasticity and postsynaptic structure
core_role: The shared pathways are activity-dependent synaptic plasticity and local synaptic translation, implemented through postsynaptic actin, density structure and receptor trafficking.

theme: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodeling
core_role: The shared pathways are de novo synthesis and transfer of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin, complemented by Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodeling and phospholipid hydrolysis.

theme: Metanephric nephron and glomerulus development
core_role: The shared pathways are glomerulus formation (mesangial, endothelial and epithelial development and vascularisation), the filtering unit within nephron and tubule segment development.

theme: Amino acid catabolism and transsulfuration
core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid (homocysteine-cysteine, serine) catabolism, one branch within broad amino acid metabolism including aromatic, proline and threonine catabolism.

theme: Axon guidance by netrin, Slit-Robo and ephrin signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are netrin-mediated attraction/repulsion and control of axon extension, alongside Slit-Robo and ephrin repulsion converging on Rho-GTPase cytoskeletal regulation.

theme: Nitrogen metabolism: glutamate, aspartate and urea cycle
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen handling, framed as the supplier of ammonia and aspartate nitrogen to the urea cycle and its disorders.
